_note: filename -> CSS object-position, read by scripts/build_banners.py and
published into docs/data/browns/banners.json as 'focal'. It is where the
page crops THIS image when the masthead's height cap bites.
Measured, not guessed, by the method panel's focal.json documents: the
art was overlaid with a 5% horizontal grid and the face band read off
it, then y set to the smallest object-position that puts the window's
top edge at or above that band at the widest desktop band (1360px,
where the crop is deepest). Narrower viewports crop less, so a value
that clears the faces at 1360 clears them everywhere.
0% is forced here rather than chosen. Two of the seven faces are
already cut by the SOURCE frame -- the back-row pair are drawn with
their hairlines above y=0 -- so the band's top is 0 and the only
object-position whose window starts at or above 0 is 0.
